note: comm -> process class for the AI Access Ledger (spec 21.1 Level 3, milestone-8.md section 3.2). Data, not code: the M7 adapters-as-data precedent. Deliberately no JSON Schema — this is an internal heuristic input versioned by review, exactly like signatures/suspected.json. Installed at /usr/share/punar/agents/process-classes.json; punar-agentd compiles this same file in as its fallback, so the two cannot drift. Anything not listed here becomes the literal class "unknown" — the raw comm is never stored. Note the deliberate duplicate "punar-mock-agen": /proc/<pid>/comm is the kernel's TASK_COMM_LEN name, truncated to 15 characters, so a 16-character executable name arrives one character short.
